```
    //@ ensures \result == (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i < adjacencyMat.length && 0 <= j < adjacencyMat.length; adjacencyMat[i][j] == adjacencyMat[j][i]);
    public static boolean isUndirectedGraph(int[][] adjacencyMat) {
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class Mul {
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        if (y < 0) {
            n = -y;
            sign = -sign;
        }

        long res = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                res = res + 1;
            }
        }
        return sign * res;
    }
}
```

```
public class Mul {
    //@ requires true;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (long) x * (long) y;
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        if (y < 0) {
            n = -y;
            sign = -sign;
        }

        long res = 0;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= m;
        //@ maintaining res == (long) i * (long) n;
        //@ loop_invariant res >= 0;
        //@ loop_writes i, j, res;
        //@ decreases m - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            //@ maintaining 0 <= j && j <= n;
            //@ maintaining res == (long) i * (long) n + j;
            //@ loop_invariant res >= (long) i * (long) n;
            //@ loop_writes j, res;
            //@ decreases n - j;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                res = res + 1;
            }
        }
        return sign * res;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;

        }

        return true;
    }
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {

            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    //@  assigns \nothing;
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    //@ ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length;

    //@ also
    //@ requires arr == null;
    //@ ensures \result == null;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ pure
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {

        char[] ret = new char[n];
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    //@   )

    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {

        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];
        int top1    = rec1[3];

        int left2   = rec2[0];
        int bottom2 = rec2[1];
        int right2  = rec2[2];
        int top2    = rec2[3];

        return !(bottom2 >= top1 ||
                 top2 <= bottom1 ||
                 left2 >= right1 ||
                 right2 <= left1);
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {

            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
```
```
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));
    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;

}
```

```
public class IsStrictlyMonotonic {
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;
```

```
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

}
```

```
public class IsUndirectedGraph {
    public static boolean isUndirectedGraph(int[][] adjacencyMat) {
        int nVert = adjacencyMat.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < nVert; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < nVert; j++) {
                if (adjacencyMat[i][j] != adjacencyMat[j][i]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));
    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```
```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
```

```
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {

        char[] ret = new char[n];
```

```
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; 
        //@     (Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> ret[j] == arr[j]) &&
        //@     (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> (

        //@ loop_writes ret[0..n-1], i, wordStart;
        //@ decreases n - i;

            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {

                wordStart = true;
```

assistant: ```
public class TitleCase {
    //@ requires true;
    //@ ensures (arr == null && \result == null) || 
    //@         (arr != null && \result != null && \result.length == arr.length &&
    //@          (\forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; 
    //@             (Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> \result[i] == arr[i]) &&
    //@             (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> (
    //@                 (i == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1])) ==> \result[i] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[i]) &&
    //@                 !(i == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1])) ==> \result[i] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[i])
    //@             ))
    //@          )
    //@         );
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; 
        //@     (Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> ret[j] == arr[j]) &&
        //@     (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> (
        //@         (j == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[j-1])) ==> ret[j] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[j]) &&
        //@         !(j == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[j-1])) ==> ret[j] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[j])
        //@     ))
        //@ );
        //@ loop_invariant (wordStart == (i == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1])));
        //@ loop_writes ret[0..n-1], i, wordStart;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
        char[] ret = new char[n];
```

```
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; 
        //@     (Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> ret[j] == arr[j]) &&

                wordStart = true;

                wordStart = false;
```

public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

public class ScalarProductSaturated {
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
}

public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```

        //@ maintaining (i > 0) ==> (dec == (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; nums[j] > nums[j + 1]));
        //@ loop_writes i, inc, dec;
        //@ decreases n - 1 - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
    }
}

        if (a == null || b == null) {
            return a == b;

            return false;

public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class LeapYear {
    public static boolean isLeapYear(int year) {
        boolean leap = false;

        if (year % 4 == 0) {
            if (year % 100 == 0) {
                if (year % 400 == 0)
                    leap = true;
                else
                    leap = false;
            } else
                leap = true;
        } else

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {

    }
}

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {

        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;

public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;

}

    //@          <==> (arr == null || arr.length == 0 || (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i < j < arr.length; arr[i] != arr[j]));
    //@ ensures (\result >= 0)
    //@          ==> (arr != null && arr.length > 0
    //@               && 0 <= \result && \result < arr.length - 1
    //@               && (\exists int j; \result < j < arr.length && arr[\result] == arr[j])
    //@               && (\forall int k; 0 <= k < \result; \forall int l; k < l < arr.length; arr[k] != arr[l])
    //@               && (\forall int m; 0 <= m < \result; 
    //@                       (\forall int n; m < n < arr.length; arr[m] != arr[n])));
    //@ ensures (\result >= 0)
    //@          ==> (\forall int p; 0 <= p < \result; 
    //@                  (\forall int q; p < q < arr.length; arr[p] != arr[q]));
    public static int idxFirstElemWithDuplicate(int[] arr) {
        if (arr == null || arr.length == 0) return -1;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= arr.length - 1;
        //@ maintaining arr != null && arr.length > 0;
        //@ maintaining \forall int k; 0 <= k < i; \forall int l; k < l < arr.length; arr[k] != arr[l];
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases arr.length - 1 - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length - 1; i++) {
            //@ maintaining i + 1 <= j <= arr.length;
            //@ maintaining arr != null && arr.length > 0;
            //@ maintaining \forall int m; i + 1 <= m < j; arr[i] != arr[m];
            //@ loop_writes j;
            //@ decreases arr.length - j;
            for (int j = i + 1; j < arr.length; j++) {
                if (arr[i] == arr[j]) {
                    return i;
                }
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }
}

    public static int idxFirstElemWithDuplicate(int[] arr) {
        if (arr == null || arr.length == 0) return -1;

        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length - 1; i++) {

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];

            }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    //@          (digits[i] == 6 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 9) ||
    //@          (digits[i] == 9 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 6)))
    //@   && (digits.length % 2 == 0 || 
    //@       (digits[digits.length / 2] == 0 || digits[digits.length / 2] == 1 || digits[digits.length / 2] == 8))
    //@ );
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= len / 2;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i;
        //@   ((digits[j] == 0 && digits[len - j - 1] == 0) ||
        //@    (digits[j] == 1 && digits[len - j - 1] == 1) ||
        //@    (digits[j] == 8 && digits[len - j - 1] == 8) ||
        //@    (digits[j] == 6 && digits[len - j - 1] == 9) ||
        //@    (digits[j] == 9 && digits[len - j - 1] == 6));
```
```
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases (len / 2) - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class ReverseArray {
    public static int[] reverse(int[] original) {
        int n = original.length;
        int[] res = new int[n];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            res[i] = original[n - i - 1];
        }
        return res;

}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    //@ requires (operator != '/' && operator != '%') || num2 != 0;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
```

```
public class IsRectangleOverlap {
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];
        int top1    = rec1[3];

        int left2   = rec2[0];
        int bottom2 = rec2[1];
        int right2  = rec2[2];
        int top2    = rec2[3];

        return !(bottom2 >= top1 ||
                 top2 <= bottom1 ||
                 left2 >= right1 ||
                 right2 <= left1);
    }
}
```

```
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
```

```
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class Mul {
    //@ requires x != Integer.MIN_VALUE && y != Integer.MIN_VALUE;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (long) x * (long) y;
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        if (y < 0) {
            n = -y;
            sign = -sign;
        }

        long res = 0;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= m;
        //@ maintaining res == (long) i * (long) n;
        //@ loop_writes i, res;
        //@ decreases m - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            //@ maintaining 0 <= j <= n;
            //@ maintaining res == (long) i * (long) n + (long) j;
            //@ loop_writes j, res;
            //@ decreases n - j;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                res = res + 1;
            }
```

```
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        return ret;
```

```
public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class TwoSum {
    public static int[] twoSum(int[] nums, int target) {
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
                if (nums[i] + nums[j] == target) {
                    return new int[] {i, j};
                }
            }
        }
        return new int[0];
    }
}
```

```
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

            return false;
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {

        }

        return true;
    }
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    //@ assigns \nothing;
```
```
    //@ ensures \fresh(\result);
    //@ ensures \result.length == original.length;
    //@ ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < \result.length; \result[i] == original[\result.length - 1 - i];
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsRectangleOverlap {
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];
        int top1    = rec1[3];

        int left2   = rec2[0];
        int bottom2 = rec2[1];
        int right2  = rec2[2];
        int top2    = rec2[3];

        return !(bottom2 >= top1 ||
                 top2 <= bottom1 ||
                 left2 >= right1 ||
                 right2 <= left1);
    }
}
```

```
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
```

```
    //@  assigns \nothing;
```
```
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {

        int n = arr.length;
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;
```

```
    //@ ensures (\forall int i; i != a && i != b && 0 <= i && i < arr.length; arr[i] == \old(arr[i]));
    public static void swap(int[] arr, int a, int b) {
        if (arr == null || a >= arr.length || a < 0 || b >= arr.length ||
            b < 0) {
            return;
        }
        int temp = arr[a];
        arr[a] = arr[b];
        arr[b] = temp;
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;

                }
            }
        }
        return true;
```

```
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));
    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
```

```
            return false;
```

```
public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

        }

        return true;
    }
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    //@ requires mat != null;
    //@ requires (\forall int i; 0 <= i < mat.length; mat[i] != null);
    //@ requires (\forall int i; 0 <= i < mat.length - 1; mat[i].length == mat[i+1].length);
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (
    //@   mat.length == 0
    //@   || (\forall int i, j; 1 <= i < mat.length && 1 <= j < mat[0].length; mat[i][j] == mat[i-1][j-1])
    //@ );
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        //@ maintaining 1 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int x, y; 1 <= x < i && 1 <= y < m; mat[x][y] == mat[x-1][y-1]);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            //@ maintaining 1 <= j <= m;
            //@ maintaining (\forall int y; 1 <= y < j; mat[i][y] == mat[i-1][y-1]);
            //@ loop_writes j;
            //@ decreases m - j;
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```
public class Add {
```
```
    //@ requires true;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
```
```
    //@ ensures \result == x + y;
    public static int add(int x, int y) {
        int sum = x;
        if (y > 0) {
            int n = y;
            //@ maintaining 0 <= n && sum == x + (y - n);
            //@ decreases n;
            while (n > 0) {
                sum = sum + 1;
                n = n - 1;
            }
        } else {
            int n = -y;
            //@ maintaining 0 <= n && sum == x - (y + n);
            //@ decreases n;
```

assistant:
```
public class DivArrayByTwo {
```
```
    //@  requires arr == null;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@ also
    //@  requires arr != null;
    //@  assigns arr[*];
    //@  ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; arr[i] == \old(arr[i]) / 2;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static void DivArrayByTwo(int[] arr) {
        if (arr == null)
            return;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= arr.length;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; arr[j] == \old(arr[j]) / 2;
        //@ maintaining \forall int k; i <= k < arr.length; arr[k] == \old(arr[k]);

        //@ decreases arr.length - i;

        }
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];

            }

            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||

                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```
```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    //@          (\forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; 
```
```
    //@              // Whitespace characters remain unchanged
    //@              (Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> \result[i] == arr[i]) &&
    //@              // Non-whitespace characters are title-cased if at word start, else lower-cased
    //@              (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==>

    //@              )
    //@          ) &&
    //@          // The output array is a character-wise transformation of input preserving length
    //@          // and no other characters introduced or removed
    //@          true
    //@         );
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
        //@ maintaining \fresh(ret);
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < i;
        //@     (Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) ==> ret[k] == arr[k]) &&
        //@     (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) ==>
        //@         ((k == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[k-1])) ==> ret[k] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[k])) &&
        //@         (k > 0 && !Character.isWhitespace(arr[k-1]) ==> ret[k] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[k]))
        //@     )
        //@ );
        //@ maintaining wordStart == (i == 0 || (i > 0 && Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1])));
        //@ loop_writes ret[*], wordStart, i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    //@          )
    //@         );
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {

        char[] ret = new char[n];

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
```
```
        //@ maintaining \fresh(ret);

            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;

                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
```

```
    //@ ensures \result == (\num_occurrences(ch, arr, start, end));

    private static /*@ pure @*/ int num_occurrences(char ch, char[] arr, int start, int end) {
        int count = 0;
        for (int i = start; i < end; i++) {
            if (arr[i] == ch) count++;
        }
        return count;
    }
```

```
    //@          \fresh(\result) &&

    //@          // and no other characters introduced or removed
    //@          true

    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
        //@ maintaining \fresh(ret);
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < i;
        //@     (Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) ==> ret[k] == arr[k]) &&
        //@     (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) ==>
        //@         ((k == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[k-1])) ==> ret[k] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[k])) &&

        //@     )
        //@ );
        //@ maintaining wordStart == (i == 0 || (i > 0 && Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1])));
        //@ loop_writes ret[*], wordStart, i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
```

```
    //@          // The output array is a permutation of the input array's characters (same multiset)

    //@          )
    //@         );
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {

```
```
public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

                return null;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {

        }

        return ret;
    }
}

```
```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;

        return true;
    }

public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class TitleCase {
    //@ requires true;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures (arr == null ==> \result == null) &&
    //@         (arr != null ==> \result != null &&
    //@          \result.length == arr.length &&

    //@              (Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> \result[i] == arr[i]) &&
    //@              (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) && (i == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1])) ==> \result[i] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[i])) &&
    //@              (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) && !(i == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1])) ==> \result[i] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[i]))
    //@          )
    //@         );
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i;
        //@     (Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> ret[j] == arr[j]) &&
        //@     (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) && (j == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[j-1])) ==> ret[j] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[j])) &&

        //@ );

public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

            ret[i] = a[i];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {

public class ScalarProductSaturated {
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
}

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```
public class Find {
    public static int find(int[] arr, int elem) {
        if (arr == null)
            return -1;

        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++)
            if (arr[i] == elem)
                return i;
        return -1;
    }
}

public class ScalarProductSaturated {
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
}

```
public class Mul {
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        if (y < 0) {
            n = -y;
            sign = -sign;
        }

        long res = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                res = res + 1;
            }
        }
        return sign * res;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    //@ requires digits != null;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (
    //@   digits.length == 0 || (
    //@     (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < digits.length / 2;
    //@       ((digits[i] == 0 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 0) ||
    //@        (digits[i] == 1 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 1) ||
    //@        (digits[i] == 8 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 8) ||
    //@        (digits[i] == 6 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 9) ||
    //@        (digits[i] == 9 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 6))
    //@     ) &&
    //@     (digits.length % 2 == 0 || 
    //@       (digits[digits.length / 2] == 0 || digits[digits.length / 2] == 1 || digits[digits.length / 2] == 8))
    //@   )
    //@ );
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= len / 2;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i;
        //@   ((digits[j] == 0 && digits[len - j - 1] == 0) ||
        //@    (digits[j] == 1 && digits[len - j - 1] == 1) ||
        //@    (digits[j] == 8 && digits[len - j - 1] == 8) ||
        //@    (digits[j] == 6 && digits[len - j - 1] == 9) ||
        //@    (digits[j] == 9 && digits[len - j - 1] == 6))
        //@ );
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases (len / 2) - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        //@ assert (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < len / 2;
        //@   ((digits[i] == 0 && digits[len - i - 1] == 0) ||
        //@    (digits[i] == 1 && digits[len - i - 1] == 1) ||
        //@    (digits[i] == 8 && digits[len - i - 1] == 8) ||
        //@    (digits[i] == 6 && digits[len - i - 1] == 9) ||
        //@    (digits[i] == 9 && digits[len - i - 1] == 6))
        //@ );
        //@ assert len % 2 == 0;
        return true;
    }
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```
public class Find {
```
```
    //@  requires true;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures (arr == null) ==> (\result == -1);
    //@  ensures (arr != null && (\exists int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; arr[i] == elem)) ==> (0 <= \result && \result < arr.length && arr[\result] == elem);
    //@  ensures (arr != null && !(\exists int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; arr[i] == elem)) ==> (\result == -1);
    public static int find(int[] arr, int elem) {
        if (arr == null)
            return -1;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= arr.length;
        //@ maintaining !(\exists int j; 0 <= j < i; arr[j] == elem);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases arr.length - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++)
            if (arr[i] == elem)
                return i;
        return -1;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    //@ also
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

assistant: ```
public class ArrayConcat {
    //@  requires a != null && b != null && (long) a.length + b.length <= Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result != null;
    //@  ensures \result.length == a.length + b.length;
    //@  ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length; \result[i] == a[i];
    //@  ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < b.length; \result[i + a.length] == b[i];
    //@ also
    //@  requires a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == null;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= m;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; ret[j] == a[j];
        //@ maintaining \forall int k; i <= k < m + n; ret[k] == 0;
        //@ loop_writes ret[*], i;
        //@ decreases m - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
```

```
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;

                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
```

```
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
```

```
    //@ also

    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;
```

```
        int nVert = adjacencyMat.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < nVert; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < nVert; j++) {

                }
            }
        }
```

```
    //@ requires (\forall int i; 0 <= i < adjacencyMat.length; adjacencyMat[i] != null && adjacencyMat[i].length == adjacencyMat.length);
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i < adjacencyMat.length && 0 <= j < adjacencyMat.length; adjacencyMat[i][j] == adjacencyMat[j][i]);
    public static boolean isUndirectedGraph(int[][] adjacencyMat) {
```

```
public class Mul {
    //@ requires x != Integer.MIN_VALUE && y != Integer.MIN_VALUE;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (long) x * (long) y;
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        if (y < 0) {
            n = -y;
            sign = -sign;
        }

        long res = 0;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= m;
        //@ maintaining res == (long) i * (long) n;
        //@ loop_writes i, res;
        //@ decreases m - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            //@ maintaining 0 <= j && j <= n;
            //@ maintaining res == (long) i * (long) n + (long) j;
            //@ loop_writes j, res;
            //@ decreases n - j;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                res = res + 1;
            }
        }
        return sign * res;
    }
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
```

```
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {

            return false;
```

public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

        while (i < pat.length()) {

    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }

public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

    //@ ensures (arr == null && \result == null) ||

    //@          \result != null &&

    //@              (Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> \result[i] == arr[i]) &&
    //@              (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> 
    //@                ( (i == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1])) ==> \result[i] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[i]) ) &&
    //@                ( !(i == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1])) ==> \result[i] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[i]) )
    //@              )
    //@          )
    //@         );
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i;

public class CompareArray {
    public static boolean arrcmp(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null) {
            return a == b;
        }
        if (a.length != b.length) {
            return false;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            if (a[i] != b[i]) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class CompareArray {
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (
    //@      (a == null && b == null) ||
    //@      (a != null && b != null && a.length == b.length &&
    //@       (\forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length; a[i] == b[i]))
    //@  );
    public static boolean arrcmp(int[] a, int[] b) {

    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));

    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {

            return false;
