    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];
        int top1    = rec1[3];

        int top2    = rec2[3];

                 top2 <= bottom1 ||
                 left2 >= right1 ||
                 right2 <= left1);
    }
}

        int res = a[0];

        //@ maintaining 1 <= i <= a.length;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; res <= a[j];
        //@ maintaining \exists int j; 0 <= j < i; res == a[j];
        //@ loop_writes res, i;
        //@ decreases a.length - i;
        for (int i = 1; i < a.length; i++) {
            res = ((a[i] < res) ? a[i] : res);
        }
        return res;
    }

    //@ assigns \nothing;

    public static boolean isUndirectedGraph(int[][] adjacencyMat) {

    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));
    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

}

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

```

    //@ assigns \nothing;

    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {

            //@ loop_writes j;

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }

**Correction:**

The error "LoopInvariantBeforeLoop" means the loop invariant must hold before the first iteration, i.e., when `i == 0`. However, the original invariant states:

```java
//@ maintaining inc == (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; nums[j] < nums[j + 1]);
//@ maintaining dec == (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; nums[j] > nums[j + 1]);
```

When `i == 0`, the ranges `0 <= j < 0` are empty, so the universal quantifications are vacuously true, which matches the initial values `inc = true` and `dec = true`. This should be acceptable.

But the prover may have trouble with `0 <= i <= n - 1` because when `n == 0` or `n == 1`, the loop condition `i < n - 1` means `i < -1` or `i < 0`, so the loop does not execute. The invariant must hold even if the loop does not execute.

To fix this, we can adjust the loop invariant bounds to:

```java
//@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n - 1 || (n == 0 || n == 1 && i == 0);
```

But a simpler fix is to change the loop invariant to:

```java
//@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n - 1;
```

and add a precondition that `n >= 1` (i.e., `nums.length >= 1`), or handle the empty array case separately.

Alternatively, we can change the loop invariant to:

```java
//@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n - 1 || (n <= 1 && i == 0);
```

But since the loop runs from `i = 0` to `i < n - 1`, if `n <= 1`, the loop never executes, and the invariant must hold at `i == 0`.

Therefore, the correct invariant is:

```java
//@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n - 1 || (n <= 1 && i == 0);
```

Here is the updated code with the corrected loop invariant:

```
public class IsStrictlyMonotonic {
    //@ requires nums != null;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (
    //@     (\forall int i; 0 <= i < nums.length - 1; nums[i] < nums[i + 1]) ||
    //@     (\forall int i; 0 <= i < nums.length - 1; nums[i] > nums[i + 1])
    //@ );
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        //@ maintaining (0 <= i && i <= n - 1) || (n <= 1 && i == 0);
        //@ maintaining inc == (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; nums[j] < nums[j + 1]);
        //@ maintaining dec == (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; nums[j] > nums[j + 1]);
        //@ loop_writes i, inc, dec;
        //@ decreases n - 1 - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
    }
}

            return false;

        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

public class CompareArray {
    public static boolean arrcmp(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null) {
            return a == b;
        }
        if (a.length != b.length) {
            return false;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            if (a[i] != b[i]) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

    //@ requires arr == null || (\forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; true);
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures arr == null ==> \result == null;
    //@ ensures arr != null ==> \result != null && \result.length == arr.length;
    //@ ensures arr != null ==> (\forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length;
    //@     (Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> \result[i] == arr[i]) &&
    //@     (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) && (i == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1])) ==> \result[i] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[i])) &&
    //@     (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) && i > 0 && !Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1]) ==> \result[i] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[i])));
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i;
        //@     (Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> ret[j] == arr[j]) &&
        //@     (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) && (j == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[j-1])) ==> ret[j] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[j])) &&
        //@     (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) && j > 0 && !Character.isWhitespace(arr[j-1]) ==> ret[j] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[j]));
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == null;

    //@ behaviors complete;
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= m;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; ret[j] == a[j]);
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; i <= k < m + n; ret[k] == 0);
        //@ loop_writes ret[*], i;
        //@ decreases m - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j < m; ret[j] == a[j]);
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; ret[j + m] == b[j]);
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; i + m <= k < m + n; ret[k] == 0);
        //@ loop_writes ret[*], i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

        }

        return ret;
    }
